property_summary: For any non-empty array of recipients and any transfer amount, a successful call to C.transfer performs exactly one external transferFrom call per recipient, so a recording callee must observe exactly _tos.length successful calls; the mutant's loop bound i<=_tos.length performs an extra out-of-bounds access and reverts, so it can never complete and thus violates the rule for every admissible input.
change_summary: Change loop bound from i<_tos.length to i<=_tos.length, causing an out-of-bounds array access and revert on every call.
